thread:
sam: Heads up — seeing a weird drop in decision-log coverage for requests that hit the override route. Canary fallback rate jumped ~3% after the last deploy. Anyone oncall who can quick-triage?

infra-bot: ALERT: service=inference-canary metric=route_fallback_rate value=0.032 threshold=0.02 link=https://metrics/redwood/route_fallbacks

anya: @sam can you paste an example request and a trace id? is this only when the override header is present?

sam: repro request below. note header casing — downstream services sometimes send `x-user-tenant` instead of `X-User-Tenant`. Decision log missing for this trace id.
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" -H "x-user-tenant: acme-prod" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate
# trace_id: trace-205876-7b9
```

kevin: hmm. sampler/decision-logger runs before header normalization in our current pipeline. If the sampler is keyed on `X-User-Tenant` (title-case) it won't match `x-user-tenant` and we drop the match.

anya: can you fetch the raw route-eval trace for that trace id? `tools/route-inspect fetch trace-205876-7b9 --raw` should show prefilter headers and sample decision point.

sam: output (trimmed):
```
PREFILTER: headers={"x-user-tenant":"acme-prod","x-request-id":"r-123"}
SAMPLER: matched=false rule_id=override-tenant-sampled reason="header mismatch: X-User-Tenant not present"
ROUTER: fallback=true selected_variant=small-latency
```

kevin: yep — sampler uses `header_in('X-User-Tenant')`. Two options: 1) enable header normalization earlier so sampler sees normalized keys; 2) update sampler rules to be case-insensitive / check aliases. I prefer 1) to keep rules simpler.

anya: config flag we can toggle in runtime: 
```yaml
runtime: 
  preroute: 
    normalize_headers: true  # currently false in canary
  sampler: 
    run_after_normalization: true  # fallback option
```

kevin: if we flip `normalize_headers` in canary, we need to make sure performance impact is negligible. Suggest a quick canary patch: enable normalization for 5% traffic and add a histogram for `prefilter.normalize.ms`. Also add an integration test: send mixed-case headers and assert decision log present.

sam: +1. I'll open a short PR with the flag flip + metrics. Action items: sam -> PR, kevin -> add unit test and infra alert rule update, anya -> run decision-log query to patch missing traces into the audit store.

anya: query command I'll run: `./tools/decision-logs rehydrate --trace trace-205876-7b9 --from raw-traces` (will follow up in thread).

sam: thanks all. tagging @kevin for the test plan. :thumbsup:

kevin: on it. I'll also add a temporary backwards-compatible sampler rule: `headers.any_case('x-user-tenant')` until normalization is fully rolled out.

infra-bot: NOTE: deploy planned 2025-06-09 02:00 UTC — if we need to rollback the canary, trigger `infra rollback canary inference-canary`

sam: filing the ticket now. I'll include the trimmed trace and the suggested config diff.
